chapters.title: 01 / Your workspace
chapters.caption: See tasks, worker health and saved results in one place.

chapters.title: 02 / Add useful context
chapters.caption: Add a brief the assistant can read during a task.

chapters.title: 03 / Give it a task
chapters.caption: Describe the work, then submit it to the durable queue.

chapters.title: 04 / Follow the work
chapters.caption: The worker executes document, calculation and artifact tools.

chapters.title: 05 / Keep the result
chapters.caption: Inspect the saved answer and download the text artifact.

chapters.title: 06 / Stay in control
chapters.caption: Cancel running work. Its history remains available to inspect.

chapters.title: 07 / Manage access
chapters.caption: Give integrations scoped tokens, then revoke access when needed.

chapters.title: 08 / Make recovery routine
chapters.caption: Review the status of a real, checksum-verified database backup.

chapters.title: Agent Kit 2.0 / ZeroLabs
chapters.caption: Run the workspace on your server. Bring your own OpenAI account.

disclosure: Real application in an isolated demo workspace. Model responses and token counts are scripted. Document access, calculation, task execution, artifact download, cancellation, token revocation and local backup were exercised.
